title: fix(metadata): a stored package-less row the boot pass files under the host's package is one holder of an action name, not two, in the bare read's judgement
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBEDksiNafxfXRXpB1X2HVS)_ Fixes #32791 domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTb2uksUmXXyE2gwCp (card thread; claim 6832821089) Clause-②: no — the fix removes a refusal ADR-0150 D4 already denies ("A package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item. … it never arms beside the item it shadows (E1) and never makes the name ambiguous."), and the refusal it removes is #32560's, which has not shipped: the refusal and its removal first ship in the same release, so no released accept set widens. On a host that declares its package, after the boot priming pass and before any write that carries no package, `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` and `getDiagnosed` of a name one package holds beside a package-less stored row saved last go from `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the host's package to the package-less row, that package's customization (or the environment's own item where the package binds the name to another object); beside two packages the `409` no longer names the host's package. Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is how many holders a read naming no package counts for one stored row. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：宿主声明了自己的包时，启动预载会给库里的无包行盖上宿主包戳，放进宿主的槽。不带包名按名读动作、要同时看 loader 时，这一行以前被算了两次（宿主包一次、环境一次）。现在按 D4 的写入规则只算一次：一个包持有时算它的定制，否则算环境自己的项。 - 为什么改：#32560 合入后，这种组合下的裸读 409 多点名了一个并不存在的持有者 `com.host.app`（专题 #31527 红线 2：歧义要如实报告）。专题座位裁定这是 #32560 的回归，发版前单独修。 - 风险与回滚：只动"不带包名的读"的裁判视图，且只针对存储型 loader 交出、盖着所在槽包戳、没有覆盖内存项的无包行。读具体包、其余八个按包类型、裸删除都不变。只在启动后、任何不带包的写入前成立（写入后见 #32812，删除见 #32813）。同一个 manager 再跑一遍预载时，新交出的行继承被替换行的覆盖标记（重复预载保持覆盖标记，评审 S3）。第一方没有接数据库加载器的宿主，仓库里的应答不变。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `slotViewOf`（`asStored` 分支的三个条件和 `aliases`）和 `writeRegistryEntry` 里打标记的那几行；`package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `packagelessWriteKeyOf` 与 `inheritStoreWriteOrder` 的 `aliases`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32791`，应见 16 passed（main 的源码下 7 个非 CONTROL 的 pin 红，9 个 CONTROL 绿）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes On a host that declares its package (`MetadataPlugin`'s `packageId`), the boot priming pass stamps a package-less `sys_metadata` row with the host's package before it registers it (`applyProtection`), so the registry holds that row in the host's slot. Since #32560 (`070e8796`), a read naming no package of an action name is judged over the registry's slots and the loaders' stored slots together (`judgesLoaderSlots`). The loaders still store that row package-less, so the one row was counted twice — as the host's package (its registry slot) and as the environment (the loader's slot) — and the refusal named `com.host.app`, a holder that does not exist. **The fix (`packages/metadata`, two source files).** 1. **`MetadataManager.loadMany` records the environment's stored rows.** An item of a type stored per `(package, name)` that a stored-row loader (`contract.protocol === 'datasource:'`, i.e. `DatabaseLoader`) hands out for no package (`indexedItemPackageId(item) === undefined`, read before any caller stamps it) goes into a private `WeakSet` (`storedPackagelessRows`). 2. **`writeRegistryEntry` marks a recorded row that replaces an item no loader handed out** (one registered in memory or by code: not in `loadedFrom`) in a second `WeakSet` (`storedRowsOverOwnItems`). That item's package held the name before the row took its slot (epic ruling B). A recorded row that replaces a marked row is marked too, so **a repeated priming pass keeps the overwrite mark** (review S3): the pass run again on the same manager hands out a new row object, which carries the mark of the row it replaces. 3. **`slotViewOf(…, asStored)`**, asked with `asStored` only by `loadSlottedDiagnosed` for a read naming no package (so `get` and `getDiagnosed`): a registry slot of a package whose item is a recorded row, **stamped with that same package** (`indexedItemPackageId(data) === slotPackageOf(key)`), **not marked**, and whose stored key a loader still holds, is set aside with the loader's copy of the row. The row is filed instead where the store files a write that carries no package (`packagelessWriteKeyOf`): the slot of the name's one package holder (D4: its customization), or else the bare slot (the environment's own item). It **keeps the write order of the registry slot it came from** (`inheritStoreWriteOrder`'s new `aliases`), so "written last" across it reads as the registry does. 4. **`packagelessWriteKeyOf` (`package-slotted-store.ts`, internal)** is the package-less branch of the store's write rule, one helper (`packagelessSlotOf`) that `storeWriteKey` and the view share. `storeWriteKey`'s own answers are unchanged. Not changed: a read naming a package; the registry's keys; every other by-package type (`judgesLoaderSlots` is `action` only); a removal naming no package (`removalOf` builds the view without `asStored`). ### Moved answers (FROM → TO) FROM is `main` with #32676 (this PR lands after it and carries #32676's C3 tightening; see below). Rows of `helper` in `sys_metadata`, one `DatabaseLoader`, the real boot pass (`MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem`), `ALPHA`/`BETA` packages, "another package" = `com.host.app`. Measured with an uncommitted probe of 32 compositions × 3 hosts (none, ALPHA, `com.host.app`) = 96 cells, reads naming none, ALPHA, BETA and the host, `get` and `getDiagnosed`: **15 cells move, all `action`, all reads naming no package; no read naming a package moves; no answer becomes a refusal.** | Host declares | Rows of `helper` (save order); items in memory | FROM | TO | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | another package | ALPHA's row, a package-less row | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the package-less row | | another package | ALPHA's row on an object, a package-less row on the same object | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the package-less row | | another package | ALPHA's row on an object, an object-less package-less row; or ALPHA's object-less row, a package-less row on an object | `409` host, ALPHA | the package-less row (the environment's own item) | | another package | ALPHA's rows on two objects (either order), a package-less row on one of them; or ALPHA's object-less row and its row on an object (either order), an object-less package-less row | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the package-less row (written last) | | another package | a package-less row; ALPHA's item in memory, before or after the pass | `409` host, ALPHA, environment | the package-less row | | another package | BETA's row and a package-less row, ALPHA's item in memory before the pass; or a package-less row, and ALPHA's and BETA's items in memory (both before the pass in either order, or ALPHA's before and BETA's after) | `409` ALPHA, host, BETA, environment | `409` ALPHA, BETA, environment | | ALPHA | a package-less row; another package's item in memory before the pass | `409` that package, ALPHA, environment | the package-less row | **Retracted relative to this PR's first head (`003d6480`, review r1), unchanged relative to `main`** (epic ruling B): a stamped row whose registration replaced an item the host's package held in memory before the pass, beside a second package's row or item — host declaring ALPHA with BETA's row or item (5 cells: BETA's row saved before or after the package-less row; BETA's item before the pass in either order, or after it), and r1's S1(c) cell, host declaring `com.host.app` with its own item in memory before the pass and ALPHA's row — answered the package-less row at `003d6480` and are refused again, as on `main`: `409` naming both packages and the environment. With no second package (host ALPHA, ALPHA's item in memory, the package-less row) the read answers the row, on `main` and here. Both hold when the pass runs a second time on the same manager (review S3; the epic seat's ruling of 22:50Z names the shapes pinned): at `f40fd775` the second pass dropped the mark, and five of the six refused compositions answered the package-less row (BETA's row saved after the package-less row stayed refused), as did the same with the packages swapped and with the rows and the host's package's item bound to objects. Also retracted (review r1 B1, B2): one package binding the name to two objects with a package-less row saved last answered that package's other row at `003d6480`, and answers the package-less row (written last) here; an unstamped row the registry filed in its one holder's slot, beside a second package, answered the package-less row at `003d6480`, and is refused here, as on `main`. Candidate order: a refusal's candidates are a set and their order follows the judged view; no contract text orders them, and the changeset says the order is not promised. The table's cells keep `main`'s order where both refuse, but review r2's probe found two cells outside it whose candidate order moves against `main`, and the epic delta read one (host declaring ALPHA, ALPHA's row, then a package-less row, `com.host.app`'s item registered in memory after the pass: `com.alpha.app`, `com.host.app`, environment on `main`; `com.host.app`, `com.alpha.app`, environment here). ### Owed item 2: the other eight by-package types No answer moves. Their bare read never reaches the judged view (`judgesLoaderSlots` is `action` only); the committed CONTROL pins the bare read of all nine types beside one package's row, both save orders, three hosts. ### Owed item 3: #32676's C3 `action` cell, tightened here #32676 lands first and holds its `package-less row saved last` / `com.host.app` `action` cell loosely (it expects a `409`). This PR removes that loose block, so the cell asserts its table row: package-less row saved last, host `com.host.app`; the loader hands out the package-less row; the registry holds it under the host's key (`com.host.app` and `helper` joined by a NUL character); the bare read and the read naming the host answer the package-less row, and the read naming ALPHA answers ALPHA's row. Its comment now says the cell is fixed. On this head the whole `database-loader.test.ts` passes (271); over `main`'s two source files that cell fails with the seven non-CONTROL pins below, and every CONTROL passes. ## Tests `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, `describe('[#32791] …')`, placed before the `[#32458]` block. Real `MetadataPlugin` boot pass over a real `DatabaseLoader` on the file's in-memory driver; every case asserts `get` and `getDiagnosed` together and a refusal's candidates in order. Sixteen cases: - moved (red on `main`): one package's row and a package-less row (also asserts the registry key and the reads naming the holder and the host, unchanged); a package's row on an object and an object-less package-less row; one package binding the name to two objects, in both orders, with a package-less row (review B1); a package-less row bound to an object beside one package's row (two shapes); one package's item in memory beside the stamped row (three cells); two packages' items in memory beside the stamped row, in three orders; the row removed from the table behind the manager (review N1: counted once while stored, the host's slot a holder again after); - CONTROL (green on `main`): two packages' rows, or a package's and the host's own, with a package-less row (five cells, hosts ALPHA and `com.host.app`); review B2's two cells (host declaring no package); epic ruling B's six cells (the stamped row replacing the host's package's item in memory beside a second package, including r1's S1(c) cell); the same with no second package (answers the row); review S3's three cases, the pass run twice on the same manager with the loader's cache dropped and kept: epic ruling B's six cells and r1's S1(c) cell in its other save order still refused (14 readings); the packages swapped, ALPHA's item and the package-less row on `account` with BETA's row on `contact`, and review B2's two cells on a host declaring no package, still refused (8 readings); and the one-package cell still answering the row (2 readings); every by-package type beside one package's row; the host's own item registered in memory after the pass.
Red before the fix - This head's tests over `main` `2ca09de5`'s `metadata-manager.ts` and `package-slotted-store.ts` (`git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree` after, `git diff HEAD` empty): the whole file **8 failed** (the seven non-CONTROL #32791 pins and #32521's tightened C3 `action` cell) | 263 passed; every CONTROL passes, review S3's three included. - At this branch's earlier heads: review B1's case answered ALPHA's other row at `003d6480`; review B2's CONTROL answered the package-less row at `003d6480`; epic ruling B's CONTROL answered the package-less row at `031037638d`; without the carried mark (this branch's code at `f40fd775`), review S3's first two-pass CONTROL answered the package-less row in 10 of its 14 readings (the four that stay refused have the package-less row saved before the second package's row) and its second in 4 of its 8 (the swapped and the object-bound cells); B2's two cells answered the row after two passes only with the stamp condition removed as well (the ablations below reproduce each).
Ablations at this head (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor hit 1, restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty) Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` (the whole file, 271 tests). | Mutation (marker) | Result | |:--|:--| | `loadMany` no longer records the stored package-less row (`R3_ABLATION_RECORD`) | 8 failed: the seven non-CONTROL pins and #32521's C3 `action` cell | | the filed row inherits no write order (`R3_ABLATION_NO_ALIAS`) | 1 failed: review B1's case | | no "replaced an item in memory" mark (`R3_ABLATION_NO_OVER_OWN`) | 3 failed: epic ruling B's CONTROL and review S3's two refused CONTROLs | | the "a loader still stores it" guard always true (`R3_ABLATION_GUARD`) | 1 failed: review N1's case | | no "stamped with its slot's package" condition (`R3_ABLATION_NO_STAMP`) | 0 failed | | both of the last two conditions removed (`R3_ABLATION_NO_STAMP_NO_OVER`) | 4 failed: review B2's CONTROL, epic ruling B's CONTROL and review S3's two refused CONTROLs | | a row that replaces a marked row is not marked (`R3_ABLATION_NO_CARRY`, this round's fix) | 2 failed: review S3's two refused CONTROLs | | the carry and the stamp condition both removed (`R3_ABLATION_NO_CARRY` held, then `R3_ABLATION_NO_STAMP`) | 2 failed: review S3's two refused CONTROLs; the probe below shows B2's two cells after two passes answering the row only here | Probe (uncommitted, deleted) of review S3's second CONTROL's cells and the object-bound variants beside them (28 readings: one and two passes, the cache dropped and kept): with the fix and over `main` `2ca09de5`'s two source files, identical, every reading refused; without the carry, the two-pass readings of the swapped cell and of three object-bound shapes (BETA's row on `contact` saved before the package-less row, BETA's item on `contact` registered before or after the pass) answer the package-less row; with the carry and the stamp condition both removed, B2's two cells after two passes answer it too. Every one-pass reading is the same in all four. The stamp condition is kept (review r2): it states which rows are the pass's, so a host declaring no package sets no slot aside. Its own pin is follow-up #32871 (review r2 N6, epic delta read nit 1).
## Acceptance notes - **Boot state only (epic ruling C on review S2, #32812).** After a write that carries no package (`register` or `registerInMemory` of the name), the registry files the written body in the host's slot and the bare read names the host's package again, as on `main`; #32812 owns that. - **Removal (#32813).** A removal naming no package is judged without this filing and is still refused naming the host's package, so in these compositions the read and the removal do not count the same holders until #32813 lands. - The filing applies only to a recorded row stamped with its slot's package: a host's own item, and an unstamped row the registry filed as its one holder's customization, stay holders. A loader that no longer stores the row leaves the registry slot counted as before (pinned). - The marks are keyed by object identity: a caller of the public `loadMany` that stamps a returned package-less row itself and registers it is treated as the pass is. No first-party caller does. - Row 5's "after the pass" cell (host declaring another package, a package-less row, the one package's item registered in memory after the pass) answers the package-less row here, while a host declaring no package or that package answers the package's own item, on `main` and here. It has one holder and is declared and pinned; the difference by host is tracked in #32752, not changed here. - First-party reach 0: no package, app or example wires a `DatabaseLoader`, and none registers an `action` in memory. - `pr_request_reviewers` is the seat's step at hand-off. ## Verification At head `392fef92` (`main` `2ca09de5`, with #32676, merged once into this branch's commits; not merged again this round, no rebase): - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test` (under the verify lock): 76 files, **2084 passed** (2084). `database-loader.test.ts` alone: 271 passed; `-t 32791`: 16 passed. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata typecheck`: exit 0. `npx eslint` on the three changed `.ts` files: exit 0. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (4 paths vs merge base `2ca09de5`, +536 / −31): 64 derived. All 64 **exit 0** at `acb26cb5` (the fix and the changeset; `@objectstack/metadata` rebuilt under the verify lock, exit 0); the last commit changes only the test file, and the 50 gates derived for that file re-ran at this head, **50 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation over that record: 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. - Probe at `f40fd775` (uncommitted, deleted): 96 cells, FROM on `main`'s two source files and TO on that head's, run in a rehearsal merge of `main` `1ec547fc` + #32676 `d50adfbf` + this branch whose `packages/metadata` is byte-identical to `main` `2ca09de5`'s: the 15 moved cells of the table, nothing else. This round changes no single-pass expectation: every r2 pin passes unchanged (the epic delta read's simulation of this fix also found no single-pass answer moving). - Not run: the full dogfood battery (no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm; this PR touches no dogfood file); a full `pnpm turbo run build` (only `@objectstack/metadata` changed this round); `pnpm lint` (CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` is the reading). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01L6bhgTb2uksUmXXyE2gwCp)_
